subject: Get it Fixed!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Microsoft are fixing these for free, so send it back and get it fixed! 🙂

You might miss it for a month, but you shouldn't have any problems after that.

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: thats what you get when....
author: drunknnumpty
body:
you dont play burnout.. lol.. just kiddin.. as Zom says send it back.. so far I have had mixed experiences with the process... have recently had to send both my original gen 1 console (which died over a year ago) and my 3rd (?) gen core system due to RRoD.. they picked up a couple of days after I raised the repair request and I even had one back within a week.. but this unfortunately RRoD after about 40mins so is being picked up again tomorrow.. the other one came back the next day and has been running fine since... you just know I'm gonna go home tonight turn it on and it will be like F U and show me the RRoD.. lol

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
